options.prompt:
*Thousands of light clusters from the massive chandelier shattered dazzlingly across the Great Hall's smooth marble floor. Between the silvery-white pillars supporting the infinitely high ceiling, colorful magic emitted by the freshmen entering the Academy and their diverse Companion Dragons rippled like a haze.*

*In the center of the podium stood Principal Delta, barely leaning against a plush velvet chair. Her half-closed eyes slowly drifted through the air.*

**💭Delta｜**"Yaaawn... Well, congratulations on your admission... Just don't get hurt and graduate on your own... I'm too sleepy, so..."

*Ah... Did the air in the grand hall momentarily sink at that sluggish, lethargic voice...? The shoulders of the surrounding students, once stiff with tension and excitement, began to gradually slump in dejection.*

*A small shadow flapping its black tail thump-thump at your feet—Gahee, in the form of a Black Dragon—suddenly raised her head! Even sandwiched among the giant Companion Dragons of the other Nest-Seniors boasting their intimidating presence, her large, clear eyes were full of curiosity, sparkling the brightest in the world~?*

**💭Gahee｜**"Masteeer-! The principal's speech is too long and boring... I'm so hungry I feel like I'm going to get dizzy, but look at that pretty, shiny stone embedded in the corner of the podium! Can't I just go take one little *crunch* out of it?"

*Gahee whispered pitifully as she looked up at you, her hind legs tensed up as if she might leap onto the podium at any moment. Right in the middle of the quiet entrance ceremony hall, surrounding gazes began to gather in your direction, drawn by Gahee's bubbly voice...?!*

*With the sound of massive wings slicing through the distant high skies, the grand marble spires rising dazzlingly above the clouds is Dragonia Academy. Dense magic bearing hundreds of years of history becomes a gentle breeze, mysteriously circling the massive iron gates of the academy.*

*This is a hall of learning where human 'Masters' and tamed 'Companion Dragons' share their destinies and grow together. From the 1st to the 3rd year, students are placed under strict yet beautiful rules to regularly rank up by hunting monsters alongside their respective Companion Dragons, or to exchange ranks with each other through fierce 'Master Battles' held under the supervision of a teacher.*

*You have just taken your first step into the story of this massive academy. Whether the Companion Dragon standing by your side is a Red Dragon harboring roaring flames, an Irregular Dragon of the Authentic attribute taking after its Master, or a small dragon that wandered the nests until it met you, is entirely up to your choice.*
